description: Auditable processing and consent signals in privacy plans and reviews

# Privacy Telemetry

In privacy plans, record observable data-processing decisions, consent-state transitions, and retention or erasure events as auditable log or metric signals. In reviews, flag findings about processing or consent signals that lack corresponding log or metric evidence. Apply the PII conventions in `telemetry-foundations`.
